colors.name: Cream Paper
colors.role: Page canvas, section backgrounds, soft card surfaces - the warm off-white ground everything sits on

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Inset cards, modal surfaces, inverse button text, nav background

colors.name: Stone Gray
colors.role: Subtle accent surfaces, inset focus rings, warm shadow tints

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Mid Ink
colors.role: Button text and border on dark surfaces, icon stroke

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Headline text alternative, deep emphasis borders

colors.name: Pewter
colors.role: Secondary body text, muted helper text, inactive state text

colors.name: Ink Black
colors.role: SVG illustration linework, deepest icon fills

colors.name: Deep Iris

colors.name: Coral Burst

colors.name: Aqua Glow

colors.name: Vivid Amethyst

colors.name: Blush

fonts.name: DropmarkRealHead
fonts.role: Display and section headings only - used at 60px for hero, 40px for section titles, 24px for sub-section headings. Medium weight is deliberate; avoids the heavy 700 convention to keep headlines calm and editorial rather than assertive.

fonts.name: DropmarkRealText
fonts.role: Body, buttons, nav, list, footer, supporting UI. 400 for body and links, 600 for emphasized sub-labels and button text, 700 reserved for occasional inline emphasis. Functions as the working sans - every non-heading element uses it.

components.name: Primary Action Button (filled)
components.role: Main conversion CTA on hero and section blocks

components.name: Outlined Action Button
components.role: Secondary conversion CTA paired with primary

components.name: Text Link
components.role: Inline links, footer links, nav links

components.name: Feature Card (horizontal)
components.role: Feature highlight blocks below the hero

do: Use #00affa exclusively for the outlined action border and filled primary button - no other UI element should carry color
Set border-radius to 3px for nav, buttons, and tags; reserve 60px for true pill shapes only
Anchor headlines at DropmarkRealHead weight 500 - do not bold-up to 600/700 for display text
Keep the page background #f7f7f1; use #ffffff only for inset cards and elevated surfaces
Lean on the accent illustration palette (#1e2554, #2c2a6c, #ff5d43, #38dede, #9164fa, #f8b3b8) for mural art only, never for UI components
Use 1px #404040 hairline borders as the primary structural divider, not boxes or shadows
Pair every primary CTA with a #00affa outlined secondary action to maintain the two-button rhythm
doNot: Do not introduce additional chromatic colors into the UI - the system is intentionally monochrome with one cyan accent
Do not use drop shadows for elevation; depth comes from surface color and illustration, not shadow
Do not use border-radius larger than 3px on cards or buttons - the flat editorial geometry is the signature
Do not bold body text above 600; 700 should appear only for rare inline emphasis
Do not use #00affa as a text or background tint for non-action elements like tags, badges, or icons
Do not place the illustration palette colors on text, borders, or background fills - they belong inside mural compositions
Do not use the cream #f7f7f1 for buttons or CTAs; the canvas color must not compete with actions
